work_window_utc.meaning: Implementation, parallel source review and focused offline checks; not live runtime or acceptance performance.

implementation: New collect_prepared_phase3_attempt consumes one attributed scheduled request against the original caller-pinned canonical preparation report, commitment and schedule. It never invokes preparation again or launches the full campaign.

Reconstruction checks exact report/commitment contracts, canonical boolean types, original chronology, seven deployment artifacts, actual imported callback source files and current collector/metrics pins. The report must already be retained by the caller.

A private commitment-keyed exclusive claim is persisted and read back before any callback, including identity_reader. All success, failure, interruption and partial claim paths preserve the claim; another attempt under the same commitment is refused.

Held directory and claim identity, source/input custody, live identity callback results and retained outputs are rechecked. Final source/input/output readbacks execute without another callback before returning.

Original preparation behavior and the full collector API are preserved. One shared sampler handles receipt and timing boundaries; verifier-owned results are canonically detached before subsequent callbacks can mutate them.
The bounded result has no metrics qualifier and all four eligibility flags are false. Local claim custody is not cross-store or hostile-owner-resistant replay protection.
review_findings_resolved: The old full collect entry point always generates a fresh random commitment, so it cannot consume an already installed broker measurement binding. The new bounded entry point retains the exact original commitment and request digest instead.
An identity callback could change input/source custody after the initial guard. A second no-callback context check now precedes the next callback or effect.
Mutable verifier-owned dictionaries could change after validation during a later identity callback. Canonical detachment now protects both the retained verification and returned semantics.
One descriptor close failure previously could skip remaining closes. Cleanup now attempts every held descriptor and preserves the original body exception, including interruption.
A misplaced negative-test assertion block was corrected during static review before the first pipeline run. No failed test record was erased or retried.

reviewed_input_closure.meaning: Explicit transitive local Python sources, the new test module and the old inert data constructor/template module. Historical test methods are not discovered. Runner, requirements, interpreter/platform and prerequisite fingerprint are separately bound.

limitations: All callbacks and clock readings in the new tests are inert doubles. A single newly affected legacy compatibility method exercises 300 inert callbacks; these are not acceptance samples or replacement measurements.
The new API has no callback timeout. The concrete embedding adapter must bound execution and clean its exact owned resources; source pins do not establish trusted semantics or dependency closure.

Preparation v1 has no boot/time-namespace identity. Ordered CLOCK_BOOTTIME values do not establish same-boot or cross-process clock-domain proof. Historical broker stamps cannot substitute for live mark callbacks.
The existing native driver is an actual gateway read/create path but hardcodes ALLOW/CREATED and lacks full timing marks. It is not an exfiltration/destructive/negative-control/task-pair callback.

The effective broker receipt interval begins after lineage and issued-submission checks. Its verifier explicitly excludes generic collector semantics, full REQUEST_ACCEPTED latency, causality, residue and task completion.
The full common host/guest capture and outer replay integration remain pending. Frozen predecessors, the staged common73 profile and retained historical evidence were not edited or recaptured.

Final31 and100-attempt/100-pair acceptance remains blocked pending real runtime/timing/workload/sink/negative-control callbacks, remaining admission and RUN/sensor semantics, and the full independent verifier inventory.
next_dependency: Reuse the actual native read/create driver, authenticated worker ingress, broker final-decision hook and physical create sink consumer to implement real boundary transport and common clock-domain evidence. Then wire real pinned execute/independent-verify/identity callbacks into genuine collection preparation and the shared host/guest preactivation seam. Do not substitute admission CLI denial or a fabricated commitment/schedule; keep final acceptance blocked.
checkpoint_commit: Create one signed local commit for this reviewed checked batch, verify signature and clean working tree, and retain its hash in ignored .aragorn/phase3-batch-<short-hash>-checkpoint.json. No automatic push.
